name: Katherine
source:
Role: Dabbler 
Katherine is boorish and vain, but worst of all she is incredibly clever. She is clearly impulsive, as evidenced by facts I am too pure to write. [Spoiler]I'm unsure how sincere her eulogy for Catherine was... she makes it sound like they had a very competitive friendship. There are also rumors about her life before the abbey that give me pause.[/spoiler] 

[Edited from the in-game description]
